main.city: chart-auth, chart-mix, kpi:auth, insight:coverage, insight:leader, table:directory — the local authority; drives the directory grouping and the not-covered-cities note
main.num: table:directory — ballot number, shown per station
main.symbol: skip: undocumented code (values 1–19 with no stated meaning); not shown
main.adress: table:directory — street + number for urban stations; for villages it repeats the locality name and is shown as —
main.yishuv: table:directory, kpi:loc, insight:single, chart-auth — locality (empty for an urban authority, which then stands for itself)
main.street: skip: redundant with adress (same street without the house number)
main.location: chart-venue, chart-mix, insight:venue, table:directory — venue free text, classified by keyword into venue types
main.district: insight:coverage — district code mapped to Hebrew; constant in the current file
main.type: kpi:reg, insight:types — authority type code (1 urban, 2 regional council)
